As a Program Manager (Deputy Division Administrator), you will: Participates with the Division Administrator in developing and implementing Federal-aid oversight initiatives and stewardship functions through an annual risk assessment of the State's Federal-aid program.

Manages process reviews to improve and enhance project and program decision-making. Recommends quality improvements in division office delivery systems for transportation projects.

Provides program expertise to State and local government officials and engineers to ensure effective program delivery in accordance with Title 23 and related applicable Federal laws.

Direct a multi-disciplinary staff, through subordinate supervisors and team leaders, in providing responsible program and project delivery, technical assistance, and training in the administration of the Federal-aid highway program.

Develop and implement standard operating procedures, manuals and guidance documents for staff to ensure consistent and efficient program delivery. Communicates organizational strategies, goals, objectives and priorities to internal and external audiences. Builds cohesive coalitions and partnerships with State and local officials.

Create and utilize assessment tools to develop, coordinate, implement, and track the Division's Annual Performance Plan. The ideal candidate for this position will have broad knowledge of the Federal-aid Highway Program.

Diverse experience in all aspects of transportation project development from planning through construction, and experience leading a team of transportation professionals. The candidate will also have several years of experience with Federal-aid or Federal Lands Highway program management.
To meet the minimum qualifications for this position, you must meet the specialized experience qualifications for the grade at which you are requesting consideration.

To qualify for the Grade 14, you must have at least one year of specialized experience equal or equivalent to the GS-13, it must include: Experience performing program management principles and practices relating to Federal-aid surface transportation programs, such as providing technical assistance and guidance to state DOTs and local agencies to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of program and project delivery, determining eligibility and authorizing expenditure of federal-aid funds, and ensuring compliance with applicable Title 23 and 49 regulations.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES (KSAs): Your qualifications will be evaluated on the basis of your level of knowledge, skills, abilities and/or competencies in the following areas: Administration and Management - Knowledge of planning, coordination, and execution of business functions, resource allocation, and production.

Compliance - Knowledge of procedures for assessing, evaluating, and monitoring programs or projects for compliance with Federal laws, regulations, and guidance.

Oral Communication - Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately.

Developing Others - Develops the ability of others to perform and contribute to the organization by providing ongoing feedback and by providing opportunities to learn through formal and informal methods. Leadership - Influences, motivates, and challenges others; adapts leadership styles to a variety of situations.

For all types of consideration, experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

For additional information about applying to Federal positions, please click on the following link: https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-policies/#url=e4 All applicants must meet all qualification requirements by the closing date of this announcement.

DO-1101-02 Interacts with many different internal and external personnel and organizations. Recommends acquisition strategies and approaches. Identifies and implements improved approaches to deliver capability. Advises and supports in the definition of requirements and budgets. Implements acquisition plans.

Accurately determines program goals and objectives. Assesses and manages acquisition program risks. Proactively identifies cost, schedule, technical and/or programmatic risks. Reports schedule risks early and develops get well plans to ensure budget execution and mission accomplishment needs are met.

Develops and implements effective risk mitigation plans. Leads source selection activities and coordinates technical evaluation efforts with project leads. Prepares a variety of documents to include requirement statements, cost estimates, market research reports, justification & approvals, acquisition plans and other related acquisition documents.

Meets due dates for procurement packages. Holds contractor accountable to meet requirements identified in their contract. Consistently applies sound principles, concepts and work processes to problems and concerns routinely keeping higher management levels informed. Adheres to security policies/directives/SOPs.
Experience requirements are described in the Office of Personnel Management (OPM) Qualification Standards for General Schedule Positions, Group Coverage Qualification Standard for Administrative and Management Positions.

Due to the use of 120-day rosters, this period of experience may be completed within 120 days of the closing date of this announcement.

In addition to meeting the basic requirement above, to qualify for this position you must also meet the qualification requirements listed below: SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE: Applicants must have at least one year (52 weeks) of specialized experience at the next lower grade DR-01 / GS-11, or equivalent in other pay systems.

Examples of specialized experience includes applying concepts, principles, procedures, regulations, laws, and/or instructions applicable to pre and post award of contracts, leading source selection activities that included the technical evaluation of contractor proposals, and/or implementing acquisition strategies.

NOTE: Due to the use of 120-day rosters, this period of experience may be completed within 120 days of the closing date of this announcement.

COMPETENCIES: Your qualifications will be evaluated on the basis of your level of knowledge, skills, abilities and/or competencies in the following areas: Problem Solving, Communication, Business Management, Teamwork and Leadership IDEAL CANDIDATE: In addition to the specialized experience statements above, the ideal candidate would have the following skills and experience: Ideal candidate is a proactive and seasoned acquisition professional who thrives in a high-stakes, mission-driven environment.

They are not just an acquisition program manager; they are a strategic thinker and a leader who understands that their work directly contributes to national security. This individual is adept at navigating the complexities of the DoD acquisition landscape and is driven by the challenge of delivering cutting-edge capabilities to the warfighter.

Program manager- Candidate has a deep and practical understanding of the entire acquisition lifecycle, from the initial spark of a requirement to the final delivery and sustainment. They can speak with authority on everything from Simplified Acquisition Procedures and IDIQs to the nuances of R&D funding.

They don't just know the regulations; they understand the strategy behind them Leadership- While the position is non-supervisory, our ideal candidate is a recognized leader. They have a proven ability to lead Integrated Product Teams (IPTs), uniting scientists, analysts, and contracting officers toward a common goal.

They build bridges, foster open communication, and are respected for their ability to listen and integrate diverse perspectives.

Their colleagues see them as a reliable and indispensable partner Problem Solving- When faced with a roadblock-be it a funding shortfall, a technical challenge, or a schedule slip-this individual doesn't just report the problem; they come to the table with solutions.

They are skilled at risk analysis and mitigation, always looking ahead to anticipate challenges and develop contingency plans. They have the business acumen to evaluate contractor proposals with a critical eye and the confidence to hold them accountable Strategic Thinking- Candidate understands the gravity of JWAC's mission.

They are cleared for the nation's most sensitive information and carry that responsibility with the utmost integrity. They are resilient, adaptable, and comfortable with the unique pressures of working in a classified environment. PART-TIME OR UNPAID EXPERIENCE: Credit will be given for appropriate unpaid and or part-time work.

You must clearly identify the duties and responsibilities in each position held and the total number of hours per week.

VOLUNTEER WORK EXPERIENCE: Refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service Programs (i.e., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community; student and social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge and skills that can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

As a your typical work assignments may include: Providing the delegated authority, leadership, management and strategic vision necessary to ensure that the division has the proper agency policies, procedures, and systems in place. Providing administrative and financial support to complete the agency's mission.

Managing all business operations program activities, may include general services functions or financial and procurement functions. Facilitating the development of short and long-range business operations program plans to support the agency goals and objectives. Coordinating with internal and external organizations and headquarters.
For more information on eligibility requirements see: DEA Employment Eligibility Applicants must meet the required qualification requirements described below by the closing date of the announcement. Applicants applying for the GS-15 must meet one of the following requirements: A.

Have at least one full year of specialized experience that is at least equivalent to work performed at the GS-14 grade level.

Specialized experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

Qualifying experience must demonstrate the following: 1) Managing the operations programs related to policies, procedures, and systems supporting administrative and financial organization's objectives; 2) Providing administrative and financial support to complete the agency's mission 3) Managing business operations program activities, may include general services functions or financial and procurement functions 4) Facilitating the development of short and long-range business operations program plans to support the agency goals and objectives 5) Coordinating with internal and external organizations and headquarters Additional information on the position qualification requirements are located in the Office of Personnel Management's (OPM) Qualifications Standards Handbook.

Time-In-Grade Requirement: Applicants must meet time-in-grade and time after competitive appointment requirements by the closing date of this announcement.

Begleite führende Unternehmen der Life-Sciences-Branche bei ihrer digitalen Transformation – mit innovativen Lösungen im Bereich Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES).
Deine Mission
Als Expert:in im Projektmanagement mit Spezialisierung auf Rockwell PharmaSuite verantwortest du die End-to-End-Umsetzung komplexer MES-Programme in einem stark regulierten Life-Sciences-Umfeld. Du steuerst globale Implementierungen, führst interdisziplinäre Teams und agierst als vertrauensvolle Ansprechperson für interne und externe Stakeholder.
Dabei verbindest du technische Exzellenz mit strategischem Weitblick: Du übernimmst die Projektsteuerung, führst dein Team zielgerichtet und trägst aktiv zur Geschäftsentwicklung bei – stets im Einklang mit den unternehmerischen Zielsetzungen und höchsten Qualitätsstandards.
Bei Accenture gestaltest du dir selbst das Umfeld, in dem du aufgehst – mit Arbeitsweisen, die zu dir passen. Du bleibst flexibel. Und wirst Teil eines Teams voller einzigartiger Menschen, die gemeinsam etwas bewegen.
Aufgaben
Führungsverantwortung in MES-Projekten.
Du übernimmst eigenverantwortlich die Durchführung von komplexen Rockwell PharmaSuite MES-Projekten – von der Planung bis zum Go-Live. Dabei leitest du Projekte und stellst die termingerechte, budgetkonforme Umsetzung im Einklang mit den Kundenanforderungen und Qualitätsstandards sicher.
Team & Zusammenarbeit.
Du übernimmst die fachliche und disziplinarische Führung eines wachsenden MES-Teams. Du übernimmst die fachliche und disziplinarische Führung eines wachsenden MES-Teams. Dabei förderst du aktiv die Weiterentwicklung deiner Kolleg:innen, stärkst durch gezieltes Mentoring den Teamzusammenhalt und stellst sicher, dass alle Teammitglieder ihre individuellen Stärken in die Projekte einbringen können.
Budgetierung, Qualität & Ressourcenplanung.
Du verantwortest die Projektbudgets sowie die Qualitätssicherung. Dabei steuerst du die Projektumsetzung effektiv und sorgst für das Erreichen der Ziele hinsichtlich Zeit, Kosten und Qualität. Zudem koordinierst du den effizienten Ressourceneinsatz deines Teams über mehrere parallel laufende Projekte hinweg und arbeitest eng mit Projektleitern sowie dem Senior Delivery Team zusammen.
Strategische Weiterentwicklung des Geschäftsbereichs.
Du arbeitest eng mit dem Leadership-Team zusammen, um die strategische Ausrichtung deines Geschäftsbereichs weiterzuentwickeln und dessen Wachstum gezielt voranzutreiben.
Presales & Kundenbeziehungsaufbau.
Du begleitest den Aufbau neuer Kundenbeziehungen aktiv – von der Angebotserstellung über die Mitwirkung bei RFP-Prozessen bis hin zu Verhandlungen mit Partnern und Stakeholdern. Damit trägst du zur Entwicklung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und zur langfristigen Kundenbindung bei.
Qualifikation
Du hast jahrelange Berufserfahrung im Bereich Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) und fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Rockwell PharmaSuite – idealerweise in einer hochautomatisierten Produktionsumgebung der Life Sciences.
Du verfügst über umfassende Expertise in regulatorischen Anforderungen (FDA, GMP), im Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) sowie im technischen Supportumfeld.
Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung in der Leitung globaler Programme sowie in der Führung und Weiterentwicklung von Teams durch Mentoring und fachliche Unterstützung mit.
Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in der Erstellung von RFP-Antworten, SOWs und im Umgang mit Preismodellen.
Du bist eine erfahrene Ansprechperson für Kunden und interne Teams und überzeugst durch souveräne Kommunikation und Präsentationen – auf Deutsch (mindestens C1) und Englisch.
Du arbeitest kollaborativ, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert – und meisterst auch komplexe Herausforderungen mit Weitblick und Effizienz.
Dein fachlicher Hintergrund basiert auf einem erfolgreich abgeschlossenen Studium in Naturwissenschaften, Ingenieurwesen oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung.

Die Accenture-Kultur: Hier machst DU den Unterschied
Deine Fähigkeiten, dein Naturell und deine Ambitionen machen dich einzigartig. Und wenn die unterschiedlichsten Talente, Stärken und Sichtweisen aufeinandertreffen, entsteht etwas Großartiges: Ideen, die in der Welt etwas bewegen. Deshalb setzen wir bei Accenture auf Diversität und freie Entfaltung. Schaffe dir ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du aufgehst.

Mit Aufgaben, die dir am Herzen liegen. Mit einem Workload, der zu dir passt. Und mit einer Arbeitsweise, die sich an deinen Zielen orientiert. Wie du dich vernetzen, weiterbilden und persönlich wachsen willst, liegt bei dir. Es ist deine Karriere. Wir helfen dir, sie so zu gestalten, wie du es dir vorstellst.

Overview Consilio is a global leader in legal consulting and services, helping corporate legal departments and law firms transform operations through technology, process optimisation, and data-driven strategies.

Our Ironclad Practice delivers end-to-end Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) implementations, combining legal expertise with structured, scalable delivery methodologies. Consilio is seeking an experienced Ironclad Project Manager to lead end-to-end client implementations within our Ironclad Practice .

You will operate within a structured delivery team, working closely with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and Legal Engineers to ensure successful execution of Ironclad CLM deployments.

This role is responsible for owning project delivery , ensuring alignment to scope, timelines, and quality standards, while driving collaboration across technical and business stakeholders.

Responsibilities Project Delivery & Governance Lead end-to-end delivery of Ironclad CLM implementations across multiple client engagements Define and manage project scope, timelines, milestones, and deliverables Monitor project performance, proactively managing risks, issues, and dependencies Ensure delivery aligns with agreed Statement of Work (SOW) , budget, and quality expectations Delivery Team Coordination Coordinate cross-functional teams including Solution Architects, Legal Engineers, and Delivery Managers Ensure clear roles, responsibilities, and accountability across the delivery lifecycle Facilitate sprint planning, stand-ups, and status reporting within agile or hybrid delivery models Support resource planning and utilisation in collaboration with Delivery leadership Client Stakeholder Management Act as the primary point of contact for client stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle Build strong relationships with Legal, Procurement, Sales, and IT teams Provide regular status updates, executive reporting, and steering committee communications Manage client expectations and drive alignment on priorities and outcomes Implementation Oversight Oversee the delivery of Ironclad configurations, workflows, integrations, and data migration activities Collaborate with Solution Architects to ensure designs are implemented effectively Ensure successful completion of key phases including discovery, build, testing, UAT, and go-live Risk & Change Management Identify, track, and mitigate project risks and issues Manage scope changes, ensuring proper governance and documentation Support change management and user adoption strategies for successful rollout Quality Assurance & Continuous Improvement Ensure adherence to Consilio delivery standards, methodologies, and best practices Drive high-quality outputs across all phases of implementation Contribute to the continuous improvement of delivery frameworks, tools, and templates within the Ironclad Practice Qualifications Required Skills & Experience Proven experience managing CLM or SaaS implementation projects (Ironclad strongly preferred) Strong understanding of contract lifecycle management (CLM) and legal operations processes Experience working in cross-functional delivery teams (Project Managers, Architects, Engineers) Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in a client-facing environment Strong knowledge of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid) Preferred Qualifications Experience delivering Ironclad CLM implementations Background in legal technology, consulting, or professional services Familiarity with enterprise systems such as Salesforce, DocuSign, Microsoft ecosystem, or integration platforms Experience with project management tools (e.g., Jira, Smartsheet, Asana, MS Project) PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or equivalent certification Soft Skills Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including executive-level engagement Strong organisational and planning capabilities Ability to navigate ambiguity and drive clarity across complex projects Proactive, solutions-focused mindset with strong problem-solving skills Collaborative approach with the ability to lead cross-functional teams What You’ll Be Part Of A high-performing Ironclad Practice delivering global CLM implementations A structured delivery model alongside Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and Legal Engineers A collaborative, fast-paced environment focused on innovation and client impact Why Join Consilio?

At Consilio, you will play a central role in delivering transformative legal technology solutions. As part of our Ironclad Practice, you’ll lead complex implementations, work with global clients, and shape the future of legal operations through best-in-class CLM delivery. AECOM is seeking an Program Manager specializing in Hyper-scale Data Centers. This position is a remote opportunity and can be based out of any of AECOM 's U.S. offices. This position offers the flexibility of a remote work schedule and can be based from a variety of locations in the US were AECOM has an office.

Although the position is primarily remote periodic travel may be required for client meetings, key project milestones, onsite collaboration sessions, or other business‑critical activities. Travel is expected to be occasional and scheduled in advance.

AECOM is a leader in the global data center consulting industry with robust teams in the Americas, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Australia. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with our teams around the world on high-profile, fast-paced data center projects for global clients.

This is a hands-on, client-facing role with an opportunity for upward career mobility. About the Role: We are seeking an experienced Program Manager to play a critical leadership role within the AECOM US Data Center Practice.

Candidate will be responsible for driving business performance, leading major proposal efforts, managing strategic client programs, and ensuring successful execution of high-value design projects.

This role operates at the intersection of business development, client management, and project delivery, ensuring that client pursuits are competitive, programs are executed efficiently, and financial and operational objectives are achieved.

The Program Manager will partner closely with executive leadership, design directors, client account managers, and discipline leaders to support revenue growth, client satisfaction, and operational excellence across hyperscale and colocation data center programs.

This position is ideal for a highly organized, business-minded leader with deep experience in managing complex A/E/C programs and supporting major proposal pursuits.

Key Responsibilities: Provide program-level leadership across multiple concurrent data center design projects Monitor program performance including schedule, budget, staffing, and risk Identify and resolve program-level constraints impacting delivery Ensure consistency of execution across multiple projects and clients Support Design Managers and Project Managers in maintaining successful delivery Support business development and proposal writing for new pursuits.

Lead preparation of major technical and commercial proposals, including: Go / No-Go coordination Proposal schedules and deliverable management Fee strategy coordination Staffing plans and resource alignment Executive review coordination Interview preparation and coaching Coordinate closely with Client Account Managers, and Technical Leaders Improve proposal processes, templates, and win strategies Support capture planning for strategic pursuits Serve as a key point of contact for strategic clients Participate in client meetings, presentations, and program reviews Support Client Account Managers in maintaining strong client relationships Help identify new opportunities within existing client programs Assist in managing client expectations and overall client experience ·Travel as needed for project-related activities such as client meetings and site visits.

Required Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or related field plus eight (8) years of relevant experience, or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.

Minimum 5+ years managing complex programs or major projects Experience supporting or leading proposal efforts Strong understanding of A/E/C project delivery process Excellent communication and leadership skills Strong business and financial acumen Ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities Preferred Qualifications: 10 plus years of relevant experience.

Direct experience supporting data center projects Experience working with hyperscale or colocation clients Experience managing large multi-disciplinary design teams Experience with Design-Bid-Build and Design-Build delivery models PMP certification preferred Professional licensure (Architect, Engineer) is a plus but not required US Citizenship Relocation is not available for this role.

Sponsorship is not available for this role. At AECOM , we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees.

Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options , well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings.

Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future.

With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned.

Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Work with Us.

Change the World. At AECOM , we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive.

We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations. There has never been a better time to be at AECOM . With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand.

We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us. Originally posted on Himalayas

Reportabilidad y seguimiento: Elaborar informes de avance, dashboards de estado del proyecto y métricas clave de desempeño para la toma de decisiones directivas.
Excelentes habilidades de comunicación asertiva y negociación.
Capacidad de liderazgo, empatía y gestión de equipos multidisciplinarios.
Proactividad, enfoque en la solución de problemas y pensamiento analítico.
Alta capacidad de organización y priorización de tareas complejas.
Modalidad de contratación: Plazo fijo
Duración del proyecto: 6 meses

LocationOur Project Manager will be an integral part of our Customer Experience team. This role is based remotely in East Coast US, the UK or Ireland. Who We Are DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation.

We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production. Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.

With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The OpportunityWe are looking for a Project Manager to support our company-wide Project Management Office (PMO), helping drive critical cross-functional initiatives from planning through execution.

This is a highly collaborative position focused on turning strategic goals into structured, actionable projects that are executed effectively and transparently.

Responsibilities Define project scopes, objectives, and timelines in collaboration with key stakeholders Maintain clear documentation and consistent communication throughout the project lifecycle Identify and implement operational improvements Oversee multiple teams, ensuring project goals are met and outcomes delivered Collaborate with internal sponsors and cross-functional teams to align on resource needs and plan project execution Manage program and project teams to drive return on investment, and coordinate cross-project initiatives to ensure alignment and progress Identify key requirements for cross-functional teams and external vendors Manage scope and timelines for projects, and where applicable, oversee project-related budgets Identify and mitigate risks and issues proactively Produce clear and timely reporting on project status, outcomes, and lessons learned Foster collaboration and accountability across global, cross-functional teams Qualifications 2+ years of experience in a formal Project Manager role, leading cross-functional projects using standard project management methodologies.

Proven ability to solve problems creatively Strong organizational and stakeholder management skills Proven ability to drive projects from initiation through completion in a fast-paced global environment Independent, creative, and proactive, someone who takes ownership and finds energy in solving problems Skilled at building relationships and driving alignment across diverse stakeholders in a cross-functional/matrixed environment Highly self-motivated, goal-oriented, and adaptable to changing priorities Analytical, data-driven, detail-oriented and able to “zoom” in/out from the big picture to the minutiae Ability to effectively operate with flexibility in a fast-paced, constantly evolving team environment Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal A great sense of humor and enjoys having fun at work BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience Bonus Points Project Management Professional (PMP) certification Familiarity with the cloud ecosystem (AWS, GCP, Azure) Are you a Do’er?Be your truest self.

Die Berufliche Grundbildung im Personalamt ist zusammen mit dem Berufsbildungsforum für die strategische Ausrichtung und Weiterentwicklung der Berufsbildung im Kanton Zürich zuständig - von der Definition von Standards und Prozessen, der Weiterentwicklung des Lehrstellenangebotes sowie gemeinsamen Projekten und Veranstaltungen.

Gemeinsam schaffen wir die Grundlagen dafür, dass der Kanton Zürich seine Vorbildrolle in der Berufsbildung weiter ausbaut und auch künftig attraktive Perspektiven für junge Menschen bietet.
Diese neu geschaffene Funktion bietet dir die einmalige Möglichkeit, die Berufsbildung in der kantonalen Verwaltung strategisch weiterzuentwickeln. * Strategien entwickeln: Gemeinsam mit den Direktionen und Fachbereichen entstehen Konzepte und Strategien (u.a. Lehrstellenförderung, Aufbau der SOG\[AB4.1\], Weiterbeschäftigung von Lehrabgänger/innen, Lehrbetriebsverbundmodelle sowie Lehrberufsverantwortliche) für die Weiterentwicklung der Berufsbildung in der kantonalen Verwaltung.

* Entscheidungsgrundlagen schaffen: Analysen, Trends und deine Handlungsempfehlungen bilden die Basis für strategische Entscheide und die Weiterentwicklung der Berufsbildung.
* Berufsbildung weiterdenken: Du erkennst Chancen für neue Ausbildungsmodelle, stärkst bestehende Angebote und entwickelst nachhaltige Lösungen, damit der Kanton Zürich auch künftig attraktive Perspektiven für junge Menschen bietet.

Senior Global Project Manager – Immunology, Metabolic, and Oncology
Sponsor-Dedicated - Fully Home Based anywhere in US

Within this sponsor, the Clinical Trial Leader (CTL) serves at the Senior Project Manager level and plays a pivotal leadership role within the Clinical Delivery Team. This position provides strategic global oversight , driving alignment, direction, and accountability across Phase II and III clinical trials conducted worldwide. The CTL ensures precise planning, efficient execution, and high-quality delivery of trials that bring speed and value to patients and investigative sites.
Operating across multi-country, multi-regional trials, the CTL provides strong global project management leadership , ensuring milestones, KPIs, and strategic objectives are met. Therapeutic areas include Immunology, Metabolic, and Oncology. Candidates must have extensive Project Management experience leading Phase II & III trials globally, with proven ability to influence and guide diverse teams.

Global Trial Preparation
Lead global planning activities and operational feasibility assessments, ensuring timelines and strategies are realistic and globally aligned.
Strengthen cross-functional cohesion by working onsite with colleagues in Statistics, Data Management, Medical Writing, Site Monitoring, Quality, and Regulatory.
Guide country allocation and feasibility processes, helping shape global site strategies with operational insight.
Develop robust global engagement, recruitment, and risk mitigation plans informed by patient, site, and regional feedback.
Lead vendor outsourcing strategy—identification, evaluation, and scope-of-work development—ensuring global operational readiness.
Bring teams together onsite to harmonize trial processes across clinical quality, safety, investigational product management, and financial planning.
Prepare or support responses to regulatory and ethics authorities across regions.
Ensure global teams are trained, aligned, and equipped for execution.
Global Trial Conduct
Maintain high-level oversight of worldwide trial operations, ensuring compliance with GCP, SOPs, and diverse regional regulations.
Monitor global patient recruitment, risks, timelines, and budgets, driving issue resolution through clear leadership.
Direct documentation changes, study amendments, and retraining across all regions and functions.
Provide strong oversight of global vendors, central labs, and external partners, ensuring consistent performance.
Serve as the connective tissue across global clinical delivery, fostering open communication and unity of purpose.
Coordinate biomarker, genomic, and sub-study activities for applicable early-phase trials, often requiring cross-regional alignment.
Trial Closeout & Reporting
Provide global leadership through data cleaning, database lock, and closeout activities.
Support CTR development and ensure timely global registry disclosure.
Ensure completeness and accuracy of the Trial Master File (TMF) across all participating regions.
Support scientific publications and global communication of study outcomes.
Strategic Contributions
Partner with portfolio leaders to provide operational and scientific insight that shapes global study strategy.
Elevate risks, bottlenecks, and insights to the Evidence Team to drive swift, coordinated solutions.
Lead or contribute to global feasibility assessments that influence trial design, operational models, and regional planning.

Required
Bachelor’s degree (4-year undergraduate degree).
Proven experience providing global leadership across Phase II & III clinical trials.
Therapeutic area experience in Immunology, Metabolic, or Oncology.
Deep understanding of global clinical trial planning, execution, and regulatory landscapes.
Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills across complex, matrixed, multicultural environments.
Ability to lead through influence, anticipate global challenges, and ensure patient-focused outcomes.
Core Competencies
Global Leadership: Confidently guide teams across regions, cultures, and functions; set vision, instill accountability, and shape high-performing global execution.
Strategic Mindset: Think several steps ahead, anticipate challenges, and align global strategies with portfolio needs.
Project Management Excellence: Expert in global timelines, risk mitigation, cross-functional coordination, issue escalation, and solution delivery.
Collaboration & Influence: Build trust across continents; unify teams through clear direction and inspiring presence onsite.
High-Impact Communication: Transparent, diplomatic, and culturally attuned communicator who elevates team performance.

This is not a traditional project management role — it is a chance to be at the center of global clinical delivery. As a Senior Global Project Manager / Clinical Trial Leader, you will be a visible, influential leader driving the success of trials that span continents. The hybrid model gives you the best of both worlds: meaningful onsite collaboration that strengthens team cohesion, paired with the flexibility of remote work.
You will shape strategy, drive execution, and help deliver therapies that change lives. Your leadership will connect people, processes, and science — ensuring trials advance efficiently, ethically, and with global impact.

Program Management duties: Supports the development and implementation of the SAPR Program and conducts ongoing assessment of consistency and effectiveness of the SAPR Program and sexual assault and sexual harassment victim care system of the installations and tenant commands in their Area of Responsibility (AOR).

Applies strategic guidance to organizational sphere of influence. Communicates directly with the Regional Commander to provide regular updates and assist the Commander with meeting SAPR program requirements.

Ensures all installation Sexual Assault Response Coordinators (SARC) document the services sexual assault and sexual harassment victims are referred to and/or requested by victims from time of initial response to final disposition of case.

Conducts periodic reviews and analyses of program operation, training, and implements back up/contingency plans to ensure service delivery for vacant SARC positions. Assists with preparations for visits from inspecting authorities.

Reviews directives from higher authority to determine potential impact on the organization; develops standardized plans, policies, and procedures for the delivery of SAPR programs. Advises operational-level leadership on SAPR-related matters.

Establishes internal administrative procedures to secure adequate control in terms of team deadlines, progress reports, and directives. Utilizes data to prioritize and gauge sexual assault response efforts and resource needs.

Determines and provides for resources to meet identified program needs, challenges and presents recommendations and assistance to influence policy. Stays abreast of Department of Defense (DoD), Department of the Navy (DON), and CNIC policies and interprets/articulates their meaning, priorities and intent.

Ensures victim advocacy services include the capacity to respond by telephone and in person 24 hours a day to victims of sexual assault and sexual harassment. Assists installation with recruitment actions and tracking of all pending personnel actions.

Recommends organizational procedures that promote communication and harmonious working relationships among the installation SAPR team to develop individual strengths, ensures team planning and product development, and meets mission requirements. Identifies and advocates for resources, information and decisions for major work issues.

Resolves simple and informal issues/complaints while referring other formal complaints to supervisor. Tracks incidents and required monthly reporting through Navy and FFSC approved databases.

Fulfills interim SARC role at installations during SARC absence or upon SARC vacancy and reports to the Installation Commanding Officer (ICO) to ensure all program requirements are met. Develops and oversees SAPR Program activities and budgets.

Program Liaison duties: Coordinates with installation Supervisory SARCs, Principal SARCs, and Installation SARCs to ensure that reports and data calls meet deadlines and that sexual assault awareness and prevention training, sexual harassment training, and victim advocacy is implemented according to DoD and Navy policy.

Assist CNIC HQ SAPR in the development and implementation of training curricula, marketing materials, and other tools to support the SAPR Program.

Coordinates with installation Supervisory SARCs, Principal SARCs, and Installation SARCs to assist in the coordination of arrangements (i.e., Memorandums of Agreement or Understanding (MOA/MOU)) to facilitate the timely exchange of information between installation victim support agencies and other commands/activities on cases involving sexual assault.

Collaborates with local community crisis counseling centers, as needed, to augment or enhance the installation SAPR Program. Liaises with Fleet and Naval Operation Support Centers (NOSCs) to ensure a coordinated response. Collaborates with other operational-level stakeholders. Liaises with type commanders (TYCOMs) and Regional SAPR Officers to coordinate services.

Mastery of concepts in program management and implementation, requirements determination, policy development and supervisory skills. Knowledge of CNIC's EEO policy and procedures. Knowledge and skill in developing and adhering to program management plans.

Knowledge of training and education techniques to implement and deliver sexual harassment training.

Skill in employing various methods and techniques typical of a sexual assault victim advocate program, including crisis intervention, situational assessment, and analyzing the needs of the victim to provide support and/or assistance to them in the resolution of complex problems.

Skill in the use of Microsoft Office Suite, Defense Sexual Assault Incident Database, and Fleet and Family Support Management Information System, sufficient to enter data, prepare reports, and develop information. Skill in providing victim advocacy and working with victims of sexual assault.

Ability and skillset to provide effective SAPR trainings and briefings to commands, victim advocates, and first responders. Ability to identify needs, trends, and performance measures to evaluate program effectiveness and provide recommendations for process improvements.

You will make decisions on resource allocations for the MOC Training and Exercise (TET) that impact Navy mission performance in support of CCDR requirements and CNO guidance and policy.
You will make policy recommendations through the chain of command to Commander, USFFC on the implementation of the Navy Operational Level (OL) training and exercise program.
You will manage/direct the design, development and institutionalization of a formal Navy MOC training and exercise continuum to enhance advanced maritime warfighting skills and procedures at all Navy MOCs.
You will manage/direct the design, development and institutionalization of a Navy-wide Fleet exercise and training continuum to better integrate Navy task force level staffs with MOC staffs in a complex maritime exercise and training environment.
You will manage and direct the development of a Navy-wide Fleet exercise and training program to enhance the readiness of the fleet to execute Distributed Maritime Operations.
You will provide government leadership, oversight and interface with supported MOCs and their respective CCMDs for maritime requirements in OL exercises and training.
You will provide direct technical and administrative supervision over at least (2) GS-0301-14 GS civilian supervisory employees and indirect supervision of (14) MOC Training Team GS-14 employees, (4) NT-6 civilians and (45) contractors.
You will assist/review work for attainment of desired results, adjusts staffing levels or work procedures to accommodate resource decisions, approve and/or deny leave, set performance standards, and evaluates work performance.
You will recommend awards/bonuses, interview candidates for positions and recommends personnel actions such as appointments, promotions, reassignments, etc.
You will hear and resolve complaints, conduct minor disciplinary measures and refer more serious, unresolved complaints to higher levels.
You will identify developmental and training needs and find eliminate and/or reduces significant bottlenecks to process improvement, promoting team building and improving business practices.
To qualify for the GS-15, in addition to the Basic Requirements for this position, your resume must also demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-14 grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector.

Specialized experience must demonstrate the following: Extensive experience in the design, development, scenario scripting, modeling and simulation, and exercise control facets of Operational Level (OL) and Large Scale Exercises (LSE) (e.g., CCMD exercises, USAF BLUE FLAG, USMC MEFEXs, or US ARMY Advanced Warfighter Exercises) utilizing live, virtual, and constructive (LVC) training environments.

Mastery-level knowledge and extensive operational experience utilizing the Navy Planning Process (NPP) and the Joint Operational Planning and Execution System (JOPES) to plan and execute joint and maritime military operations.

Direct experience serving on a numbered/major Fleet staff or Combatant Command (CCMD)/Joint Task Force (JTF) staff, with deep-seated knowledge of Navy missions, organizational structures, and command relationships (ADCON, OPCON, TACON) executed during CCDR operations.

Proven experience serving as a team lead supervising a diverse workforce (including GS civilians, active-duty military up to O-6, and contractors) and managing significant programmatic resources, including POM submissions, travel budgets, and service labor contracts in excess of $6M per annum.

Exceptional oral and written communication skills to facilitate high-stakes discussions, present critical risk-benefit analyses, and negotiate solutions on contentious issues with Flag/SES-level leaders, 3- and 4-star Fleet Commanders, and senior joint or international stakeholders.

BWT hat es sich zur Aufgabe gemacht, Wassertechnologien zu entwickeln, zu produzieren und zu vermarkten, die den Menschen eine bessere Lebensqualität bieten. Der Industrie werden ökonomisch sowie ökologisch sinnvolle Lösungen in der Wasseraufbereitung zur Verfügung gestellt.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams Projektabwicklung in der BWT AQUA Pharma \& Biotech AG suchen wir dich als
Projektleiter Pharma\-Anlagenbau 100% (alle)

Du koordinierst interne Fachteams wie Engineering, Automation, AVOR, Produktion, Montage und Qualifizierung sowie externe Partner und Lieferanten.Während der gesamten Realisierungsphase bist du die zentrale Ansprechperson für Kunden in technischen, terminlichen und kommerziellen Fragen.

Du steuerst Projekt\-Reviews sowie Risiko\- und Änderungsmanagement und verfolgst offene Punkte konsequent bis zum Projektabschluss.
Du begleitest FAT, SAT, Inbetriebnahmen und Übergaben und unterstützt bei Qualifizierungsaktivitäten.
Du bist bereit, innerhalb der Schweiz zu reisen und bei Bedarf projektbezogen auch international im Einsatz zu sein.

Du hast ein abgeschlossenes technisches Ingenieurstudium, zum Beispiel in Maschinenbau, Verfahrenstechnik, Chemieingenieurwesen, Elektrotechnik oder Automation, oder bringst eine vergleichbare Ausbildung mit.

Du bringst ein gutes technisches Verständnis für Wasseraufbereitung, Rohrleitungsbau, Automation und pharmazeutische Dokumentationsanforderungen mit.
Erfahrungen in GMP\-konformer Projektabwicklung, Qualifizierung, FAT/SAT, technischer Dokumentation sowie strukturiertem Abweichungsmanagement ist von Vorteil.
Du kommunizierst sehr gut auf Deutsch und gut auf Englisch; ösischkenntnisse sind ein zusätzliches Plus.
Du trittst sicher auf, denkst kundenorientiert und überzeugst durch ausgeprägte Kommunikations\-, Organisations\- und Moderationsfähigkeiten.
Du arbeitest selbständig, präzise, lösungsorientiert und belastbar – und hast Freude daran, komplexe Projekte erfolgreich voranzubringen.

Eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit viel Eigenverantwortung in einem wachsenden Marktumfeld.
Die Mitarbeit an anspruchsvollen Pharmawasser\-Projekten mit hoher technischer Relevanz und klarer GMP\-Ausrichtung.
Ein lösungsorientiertes, kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einem internationalen BWT\-Netzwerk.
Attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen, moderne Arbeitsmittel und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten innerhalb der BWT\-Gruppe.
Das ist BWT
Flache Hierarchien und ein familiäres, wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld. Gelebte Du\-Kultur bis in die oberste Führungsebene. Langjährige, engagierte Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die unsere Werte mittragen. Ein erfahrenes, eingespieltes Team, das dich bei deiner neuen Aufgabe unterstützt.

s.h: About the role and what you will be doing
s.t:
The Senior Project Manager provides senior-level expertise to plan, organise, control, and deliver large, complex infrastructure and data centre migration projects across Ensono's client portfolio.

Operating within the Global Project and Implementation (GPI) practice, this role manages multiple company-wide initiatives simultaneously — from scope definition and budget planning through to delivery and post-implementation review.

A key part of this position involves building and maintaining strong relationships with client sponsors and internal leaders, including regular on-site engagement at the client's London office.

The Senior Project Manager interfaces directly with client executive management to understand critical business priorities and ensures every project is completed within agreed scope, quality, time, and cost constraints.

· Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure business requirements are clearly defined, understood, and documented

· Define project scope, risks, potential issues, and resource requirements at the outset of each engagement

· Ensure project benefits are realised while managing the impact of organisational change on the business and its clients

· Develop project phases and translate them into clear, measurable project plans

· Communicate internally and externally on delivery of work products, planning activities, and cross-organisational resource relationships

· Manage projects in full adherence to Ensono's project management methodology

· Manage project scope across mission, objectives, and requirements throughout the project lifecycle

· Manage project schedules, including key milestone dates and critical path tracking

· Lead the team in identifying project risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies; act as the primary escalation point and drive effective mitigation strategies to maintain project goals

· Provide leadership and strategic direction to the project team across all phases of delivery

· Oversee all project work streams, including timeline adherence, quality of deliverables, risk management, issue escalation, and stakeholder collaboration

· Work with all stakeholders to ensure governance frameworks and continuous improvement or transformation plans are established and maintained

· Establish deadlines, assign tasks, and monitor and summarise project progress for all relevant parties

· Develop business insights through analysis of results and communicate key findings to management to support data-driven decision-making

· Secure appropriate resources and personnel in collaboration with management to ensure projects are delivered on time and within budget

· Escalate barriers, risks, and issues that may impact timelines or deliverables in a timely and appropriate manner

· Manage the development of polished executive-level presentations and deliver findings to internal associates and external clients clearly and concisely

· Manage project status reporting in line with prescribed timelines for each engagement

· Develop measurement processes and methods to assess progress towards project goals and outcomes

· Manage project costs and budgets throughout the full delivery lifecycle

· Facilitate cross-training to support job rotation and minimise gaps in assignment coverage

· Provide coaching and constructive feedback to all project team members

· Mentor less experienced associates within the project management practice

· Interface with client executive management on-site at the client's London office to understand and address critical business issues and concerns

· Proficient in MS Office and MS Project

· Strong financial management skills, including experience with project budgeting and cost control

· Effective team management skills with the ability to lead matrixed, cross-functional teams

· Strong leadership and strategic direction capabilities

· IT outsourcing knowledge

· Strong infrastructure management experience

· ITIL and/or ITSM knowledge

· Ability to organise and define work in complex or ambiguous situations

· Ability to travel to the client's office in London as required

· Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment

· Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems (MIS), or equivalent experience

· Minimum of 7 years of complex IT programme and project management experience

· Demonstrated experience managing large-scale infrastructure and data centre migration projects

· MBA or Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, or Engineering preferred

· Project financial and revenue recognition experience preferred

A major function of the Office of Data Acquisitions is to provide databases developed from state highway safety related data for use in analyses aimed at reducing deaths, injuries, crashes, and medical costs.

As the Director, the incumbent will be responsible for the following: Advising the Associate Administrator on all matters related to the design, development, coordination, and management of crash investigation and data collection, and their contribution to achieving the mission of NHTSA.

Keeps the Associate Administrator fully informed as to the status of programs and of problems and controversial issues.

Collaborates closely with the Associate Administrator and other top officials of NHTSA to identify the agency's crash research and data needs, to determine techniques and methods by which the office can meet those needs, to estimate the cost and time required to meet the needs, and to determine other implications of changes.

Carrying out personnel management responsibilities for a staff of professional, technical, administrative and clerical support personnel. Makes decisions on work problems presented by subordinate supervisors and key specialists.

Evaluates performance of subordinate supervisors and reviews evaluations made by supervisors of subordinate employee's performance. Establishing policy and provides management oversight of the State Data Reporting Systems Division responsible for the crash record-based data.

Crash record based data includes the Fatality Analysis Reporting System (FARS), a fundamental national data base on traffic safety, Crash Report Sampling System (CRSS), Not-in-Traffic System (NTS) and the State Electronic Data Collection Program (SEDC)., The Division also provides the expertise in sample design and quality control to the other offices in the National Center for Statistics and Analysis, the rest of NHTSA and other offices in DOT.

Establishing policy and provides management oversight of the Crash Investigation Division (CID), provides executive leadership in the planning, design, development, coordination, and management of national networks of motor vehicle traffic crash research and data collection activities.

These include the operation of a national system to conduct detailed investigations of a well-defined selection of motor vehicle crashes currently the Crash Investigation Sampling System (CISS)); and the Special Crash Investigations (SCI) program of special investigations of crashes of particular, interest; and Systems for collecting, supplementing, and coding data from police crash reports to provide special purpose data files.

Maintaining liaison with other Federal agencies, State and local governments, police agencies, hospitals, private safety groups, motor vehicle and equipment manufacturers, crash research and analysis organizations, professional societies, and other groups with an interest in crash investigation and crash data for the purposes are for exchanging crash data and information on crash research technology, encouraging the use of crash data, and cooperating on crash research programs.

The ideal candidate is a data executive and systems expert with a track record of managing federal data collection, automation, and national crash investigation programs.

They possess the strategic and technical skills to lead multi-disciplinary teams while directing the human resource, budgetary, and procurement parameters vital to national highway safety initiatives.

A skilled collaborator, they excel at building partnerships across federal, state, and private sectors including law enforcement, public health, and the automotive industry to secure cooperation and advance data systems.

Furthermore, they bring expertise in data governance, enforcing quality control and data completeness while protecting individual privacy, ensuring the delivery of accurate databases that support national safety research and rulemaking.
To meet the minimum qualifications for this position, you must meet the specialized experience qualifications.

To qualify for the Grade 15, you must have at least one year of specialized experience equal or equivalent to the GS-14, it must include: Experience directing multi-disciplinary professional, technical, and administrative teams while managing the organizational, human resource, and budgetary parameters vital to national highway traffic safety initiatives.

Experience communicating with system managers, rulemaking engineers, researchers, technicians, traffic safety administrators, Governor's Representatives for Highway Safety, State and local officials, national data system program managers and others associated with the application of data as it applies to helping solve complex safety issues.

Experience establishing policy and overseeing large federal data divisions to ensure data completeness, security, and rigorous quality control. Examples include working with executive leadership to plan, develop, and manage large-scale national data collection systems and multi-level crash investigation programs.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES (KSAs): Your qualifications will be evaluated on the basis of your level of knowledge, skills, abilities and/or competencies in the following areas: Technical Knowledge: Knowledge of federal budgeting to manage large divisional funds, appropriations, large-scale national data architecture, data collection methodologies, complex procurement or contracting mechanisms and systems engineering principles required to build and sustain nationwide databases.

Leadership and Supervision: Management and/or team leader skills, including the ability to direct, manage, and develop a diverse, high-performing human resources workforce of technical and administrative staff.

Communication: Communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, including the ability to secure community support, build strategic intergovernmental alliances, and establish private-sector data-sharing partnerships.

Reasoning: Ability to collaborate across federal, state, and private boundaries to improve data accessibility while balancing competing stakeholder priorities.

For all types of consideration, experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

Serve as the primary escalation point for project delivery and resource-related issues.

The successful candidate will combine strong analytical capability with commercial awareness, stakeholder management skills, and a genuine interest in contributing to the development of a modern and high-performing global organisation.**People Reward Advisory**
* Contribute to the development and enhancement of reward and recognition frameworks that support business objectives and workforce engagement.
* Provide market insights and benchmarking analyses to support talent attraction, retention, and organisational competitiveness.
* Partner with People leaders and business stakeholders on workforce-related decision making.
* Support the evaluation of workforce investments through data-driven recommendations and business analysis.
* Contribute to the ongoing evolution of the employee value proposition across international markets.
* Deliver insights and recommendations on workforce trends, organisational effectiveness, and talent sustainability.
**Workforce Planning**
* Support workforce planning initiatives across multiple regions and business functions.
* Develop and maintain reporting tools, dashboards, and workforce metrics to support leadership decision making.
* Analyse workforce trends, organisational data, employee movements, and retention indicators.
* Identify opportunities to improve workforce effectiveness and organisational performance.
* Provide meaningful people insights to support business planning and growth initiatives.
**Global Talent Initiatives**
* Support programmes facilitating the deployment and development of talent across international markets.
* Collaborate with regional stakeholders to ensure a consistent employee experience across the organisation.
* Participate in the development and enhancement of global people policies and frameworks.
* Contribute to initiatives designed to support employee engagement, talent development, and workforce sustainability.
* Coordinate with internal and external partners to support international people projects where required.
**Organisational Development & Transformation**
* Lead or contribute to strategic projects supporting organisational growth and transformation.
* Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to improve processes, governance, and operational effectiveness.
* Support the implementation of scalable people solutions across an international environment.
* Promote continuous improvement through data, innovation, and best practice sharing.
* Contribute to initiatives enhancing organisational agility and long-term workforce capability.
## The Successful Applicant ##
**Experience**
* Proven experience within Compensation & Benefits, Total Rewards, People Analytics, Talent, Mobilithy or related disciplines.
* Experience operating within complex, international, and multi-jurisdictional environments.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with senior stakeholders on business and workforce-related topics.
* Exposure to global organisations experiencing growth, transformation, or international expansion.
* Experience supporting or delivering cross-functional projects involving multiple regions and stakeholders.
**Skills**
* Strong analytical, numerical, and business acumen.
* Ability to transform data into strategic insights and practical recommendations.
* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing capabilities.
* Strong presentation and communication skills.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity and operate effectively within changing environments.
* Sound judgement, professionalism, and discretion.
**Personal Attributes**
* International mindset and cultural agility.
* Strategic thinker with a pragmatic approach to execution.
* Naturally collaborative and relationship-oriented.
* Curious, proactive, and solutions-focused.
* Comfortable challenging existing approaches constructively.
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Credible and confident when interacting with senior stakeholders.
## What's on Offer ##
This is an opportunity to join an ambitious international luxury group at an exciting stage of its global growth journey.
You will work closely with senior leaders across multiple markets and contribute to strategic initiatives that shape workforce decisions, organisational effectiveness, talent outcomes, and long-term business success.
The role offers broad exposure, international scope, and the opportunity to influence the future direction of a growing global organisation.

Reconnus comme étant le partenaire privilégié des marques du Groupe pour la production de Céramiques, Glaces saphir et Pierres d-horlogerie destinés à l-industrie horlogère.
Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous proposons, sur notre site de Boncourt, un poste de :
**Chef de projet Industrialisation H/F**
Votre engagement contribuera à notre essor tout autant qu-à votre développement personnel à travers :
* Un espace de travail moderne et agréable.
* Des conditions sociales de premier ordre.
* Une équipe dynamique, exigeante, à l-écoute et toujours en quête de nouveaux défis.
* Une volonté commune : collaborer et grandir ensemble pour devenir un partenaire incontournable.
## Description du poste ##
* Manager et être l-acteur principal de plusieurs projets d-industrialisation, d'un point de vue technique et administratif :
* En phase d-étude : recherche de solutions, plans d-expérience sur le terrain, rédaction de rapports d-essais, rédaction de cahiers des charges, appels d-offres, comparatifs, choix de solutions techniques, montage administratif de dossiers d-investissement.
* En phase de réalisation : suivi fabrication chez les fournisseurs, essais et mises au point machines, formation et transmission à la production.
* Recherche et développement de procédés de fabrication innovants et industrialisables pour la fabrication de composants en matériaux durs.
* Etre garant de la stabilité et de la fiabilité technique des équipements et procédés mis en place.
* Soutien à la production en termes de résolution de problèmes et d-amélioration continue.
## Profil ##
* Vous êtes titulaire d-un diplôme «Ingénieur HES» ou «Technicien ET».
* Vous êtes pluridisciplinaire et expérimenté : mécanique, automatisation, procédés, fortement intéressé à la fois par l-automation et les procédés spécifiques aux matériaux durs.
* Vous avez de l-expérience dans le suivi de projets industriels (automatisation + procédés de fabrication).
* Vous maîtrisez les outils informatiques courants et de langue maternelle française, ainsi que bonnes connaissances d-anglais et d-allemand.
* Vous êtes flexible au niveau des déplacements sur les différents sites de l-entreprise.
* Vous êtes doté d-une personnalité technique, résistante, constructive, proactive, communicative et structurée.
## Compétences requises ##
Nous recherchons une personne organisée, capable de travailler en multitâches avec d-excellentes qualités relationnelles tant avec les interlocuteurs externes et internes.
Dotée d-une bonne ouverture d-esprit, de créativité et de dynamisme, sachant prendre du recul et être à l-écoute.
## Langues ##
Français, l'anglais est un atout.

## Fachbereichsleiter / Fachbereichsleiterin Sozialberatung ##
Das Zentrum für Soziales ist einer der grössten Verbände seiner Art in der Schweiz.

Im Auftrag von 28 Gemeinden mit einem Einzugsgebiet von über 100'000 Personen sind wir mit grossem Engagement, niederschwellig und vernetzt in folgenden Bereichen tätig: Kindes- und Erwachsenenschutzbehörde (KESB), Berufsbeistandschaft, Sozialberatung, Mütter- und Väterberatung, Suchtberatung und Schulsozialarbeit.

Der Fachbereich Sozial- und Suchtberatung ist polyvalent tätig und bietet eine breite Palette an Beratungsangeboten an. Dazu gehören persönliche und wirtschaftliche Sozialhilfe, Jugend- und Erziehungsberatung, Budget- und Schuldenberatung, Abklärungen für Gemeinden und im Bereich des Kindesschutzes für die KESB sowie Suchtberatungen.

Zum Fachbereich gehört auch die Schulsozialarbeit in elf Gemeinden.
Da die bisherige Stelleninhaberin aus familiären Gründen in ihre ursprüngliche Wohnregion zurückkehrt, ist die Stelle per Dezember 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung neu zu besetzen
### Ihre Aufgaben ###
Aufgaben im gesamtbetrieblichen Kontext des Gemeindeverbandes
* Mitarbeit in der Geschäftsleitung des Zentrums für Soziales
* Aktive Mitarbeit an der Betriebsentwicklung und dem Qualitätsmanagement
* Externe Kommunikation des Fachbereichs in Abstimmung mit der Geschäftsführung
* Zielgerichtete, wirkungsvolle und nachhaltige Erledigung der übertragenen Aufgaben, insbesondere des politischen und betrieblichen Leistungsauftrages
* Mitwirkung in internen und externen Arbeitsgruppen, Projekten und Fachgremien
Aufgaben im Rahmen der Funktion Personalführung Der Fachbereich umfasst 47 Mitarbeitende. Ihnen direkt unterstellt sind die Teamleitungen der Sozialberatung und der Administration an beiden Standorten sowie die Teamleitung der Schulsozialarbeit.
* Personalführung, Förderung und Begleitung von Mitarbeitenden
* Sicherstellung von Qualität, Wissenstransfer und fachlicher Entwicklung
* Gestaltung von Abläufen, Prozessen und Konzepten
* Zusammenarbeit mit Gemeinden, Fachstellen, Behörden und weiteren Anspruchsgruppen
Aufgaben in der Klientenarbeit
* Beratung und Begleitung von Jugendlichen, Erwachsenen, Paaren und Familien in komplexen sozialen Fragestellungen
* Beratungen im Bereich der wirtschaftlichen und persönlichen Sozialhilfe
* Beratung in Fragen der Sozialversicherungen, Budget- und Einkommensverwaltung
### Das bringen Sie mit ###
* Bachelor oder Master in Sozialer Arbeit
* Mehrjährige Führungserfahrung im Sozialbereich
* Hohe Zuverlässigkeit und Belastbarkeit
* Konfliktfähigkeit und Durchsetzungsfähigkeit
* Kenntnisse im Controlling, Qualitätsmanagement und in der Betriebsentwicklung
* Integrative, reife und loyale Persönlichkeit
